description:
Icelook connects clients with independent beauty specialists — nail techs, lash and brow artists, hairdressers, and makeup artists. Book the specialist, not the salon.

Clients can check a specialist's real availability, book an appointment, and reschedule or cancel it — all in chat. Specialists can review their day, manage bookings, clients, and services, and check how their business is doing.

Every booking action confirms the details first, and nothing on your calendar is ever changed silently.

defaultPrompt: When is my barber free for a Men's cut in the next seven days?
Help me book my next haircut; confirm the time and price with me first.
Compare my revenue this month so far with the same dates last month.
